title: AUO's DaaZ Concept Puts Vehicle Displays Closer to Zonal Control
seoTitle: AUO DaaZ: Smart Cockpit 2027 Zonal HMI Preview
seoDescription: AUO plans to show DaaZ at CES 2027, framing displays as points for cabin sensing and control. Hardware, interfaces and production status remain undisclosed.
dek: A CES 2027 preview puts the display into the vehicle electronics architecture conversation, but gives engineers few of the details needed for a production design.
summary: In a November 12 preview, AUO Mobility Solutions introduced the DaaZ name for Display-as-a-Zonal, a proposed integration role for automotive displays and HMIs. The company plans to present it alongside Smart Cockpit 2027 and SatGlass at CES on January 6–9, 2027. This is a future exhibition preview, not evidence of a shipping zonal controller, an automotive design win or a fully specified module.
keyFacts: Product SKU and silicon: not given
whyItMatters: Automotive display modules increasingly interact with sensing and control; moving them into a zonal architecture changes wiring, compute ownership and integration responsibilities.
A display-oriented supplier describing cross-domain electronics is worth watching, but a named concept does not yet establish a qualified electronic control unit or tested software stack.
Canadian automotive engineering teams should distinguish architectural direction from components they can actually specify, validate and purchase today.

reporting.heading: AUO reframes the screen as an electronics node
paragraphs: AUO Mobility Solutions says its CES 2027 presentation will organize around intelligent interaction, computing and connectivity. Within that framing, DaaZ gives a name to a display/HMI role that also encompasses sensing, device control and local computing. Instead of being a passive endpoint for information from another controller, a screen assembly could become one of the points where cabin functions are integrated into the wider electrical/electronic architecture.

That shift raises engineering questions beyond brightness and touch accuracy. A zonal display node needs a defined relationship to vehicle networks, power states, safety partitions and software updates. AUO's public preview does not give a block diagram, processor identification, interface bandwidth, supported operating system, functional safety target or thermal limits. It is consequently too early to judge how much electronics consolidation the approach can achieve.

reporting.heading: A scheduled CES demonstration is not commercialization
paragraphs: The official November 12 statement describes what AUO Mobility Solutions intends to showcase in Las Vegas on January 6–9, 2027. It also mentions a large-format Micro LED cockpit presentation and SatGlass, the company's glass-integrated satellite connectivity concept. The combination suggests that AUO wants to be considered for integrated cockpit subsystems rather than only individual panels.

The announced exhibition is still in the future as of this publication. No demonstration outcome, production-ready DaaZ ordering number, customer design win, confirmed vehicle platform or shipment date is established by the announcement. Earlier zonal and antenna-related positioning should not be counted as newly launched silicon or an additional commercial adoption.

reporting.heading: The design-in test is the boundary between domains
paragraphs: An automaker or Tier 1 evaluating a zonal HMI will need clarity on which functions reside in the display assembly, which remain under a central compute platform and which interfaces carry sensor or control data. Security update authority, wake-up behavior, fault containment, latency and electromagnetic compatibility could matter more than an appealing concept diagram.

Procurement questions remain equally open: Is DaaZ a design service, an integrated ECU, a reference architecture or a future product family? AUO has not provided public answers about specific components, samples, licensing, pricing or development-kit availability. A first useful follow-up is to request a block diagram and integration responsibility matrix after CES.

flypigTake: DaaZ is an architectural signal, not yet a buyable part. It may become important if AUO can show how display, sensing and control functions share a validated zonal node. For now, design teams should track interfaces and responsibility boundaries rather than assuming system consolidation has been proven.
productStatus: AUO announced a planned CES 2027 demonstration for January 6–9, 2027. No public DaaZ SKU, EVK, sample schedule, mass-production confirmation, pricing, customer designation or shipment evidence was verified.
openQuestions: Does DaaZ refer to a hardware ECU, a reference architecture, a licensed integration approach or a future module family?
Which processors, network interfaces, safety/security mechanisms and software lifecycle tools sit inside the proposed zone?
What actually appears at CES 2027, and are any commercial samples or customer programs disclosed there?
canadaRelevance: Canadian automotive Tier 1 suppliers, vehicle electronics teams and HMI integrators can use the DaaZ preview as a prompt to study zonal display integration, while reserving component selection until technical data emerges.
